newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Mer Direct to buy China h'way stake.
newsitem.headline: China Mer Direct to buy China h'way stake.

text.p: China Merchants' China Direct Investments Ltd said on Thursday it plans to pay US$10 million for a 34.67 percent stake in a highway project in Guangdong province's Maoming City.
"The investment is subject to the approval of the relevant government authorities," it said in a statement.
The 45-km long highway, Provincial Highway No. 1987, is a major roadway connecting Huazhou and Maoming, one of the largest consolidated oil refinery industrial bases in China, it said.
It said the road was being upgraded and total investment in the highway was expected to be more than US$38 million.
China Merchants Direct is an investment fund jointly managed by China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd and Victor Chu China Investment Ltd.
